capabilities: Chat with the active note using vault and web context
Search the vault and web with cited source references
Create, edit, open, and undo note changes via tool commands
Maintain a structured Mindo Wiki memory layer with Raw, Wiki, Schema, and Inbox files
Run local speech-to-text and text-to-speech workflows
extras: Desktop-only because it starts local helper processes via Node child_process; optional Rust sidecar (contex-core) speeds up vault search, resolver scoring, and RAG indexing; README includes developer-oriented install/build/publishing instructions and points to separate release and security docs; the plugin was renamed from an earlier name to 'mindo'.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant for chatting with notes, retrieving vault and web context, or voice-driven workflows.

relations.evidence: Local STT/TTS helpers for Parakeet/faster-whisper and Silero/Kokoro-style speech workflows
Local STT/TTS helpers for Parakeet/faster-whisper and Silero/Kokoro-style speech workflows

summary: Local-first AI companion that chats with the active note, searches the vault, edits notes, and maintains a wiki-style memory layer.
